title: Feynman Lab
description:
Learn physics the Feynman way
A free app built on Richard Feynman's books Six Easy Pieces and Six Not-So-Easy Pieces.
* Guess first, then try it in a live simulation
* Short, clear explanations, one step at a time
* 3D views you can turn with your finger
* Change the laws of nature and see what happens
* Lessons read aloud in natural voices
* Daily thinking questions on your phone
* Lessons come back for review so you remember
